collection.title: Ford Galaxy 1995 to 2001 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ford Galaxy 1995 - 2001 model requires a 28" wiper blade for the drivers and a 24" for the passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper. The rear screen wipers we stock for this Galaxy can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
